text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the Board of Directors of CreateTO to approve the CreateTO 2019 budget.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Recommends that City Council approve CreateTO's 2019 Budget request of $13.005 million gross, and $0 net. 2. Directed that the Confidential Attachment 1 to the revised report (November 27, 2018) from the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO remain confidential as it deals with personal matters about identifiable persons and contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Directors of CreateTO and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
